components.description: Checkbox field — label (+ optional description) and a Checkbox in one tappable container; the whole row toggles. Control at start by default (forms, consent); Control at end for settings lists (turn one boolean off, the other on). React: <CheckboxField label description checked indeterminate onChange size controlPosition />. Sizes share field heights: S 36, M 44. Props: Label, Description, S

Usage
• Use when the choice is saved by a Submit / Save button — otherwise Switch field.
• Consent rows (terms, marketing) keep the control at start and are never pre-checked.
• Indeterminate only for a parent row whose children are partly checked.
• The whole row toggles; Space toggles when focused.
